# Café
Windows desktop tool for Twitch streamers.
Read [repository rules](AGENTS.md) before edits.
Read [context protocol](catalogue/protocol.json), then [subject catalogue](catalogue/subjects.json), subject index, page and advertised anchor.
Local browse convention: catalogue/protocol.json -> catalogue/subjects.json.
Read docs/ for architecture. Component identities remain future targets.
Context router available (uncalibrated). Use tools/resolve_cafe.py for exact coordinates; rebuild after source edits.
